test_title: PYST 02: SSC JE ME - General Awareness (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: For strengthening the fundamental duties, the Verma Committee identified a few existing acts by which a proper implementation of such duties can be accomplished. Which of the following was NOT referred by him?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Wildlife Segregation Act, 1970**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Wildlife Segregation Act, 1970** was not referred by the Verma Committee in the context of strengthening fundamental duties.
 
• The Verma Committee focused on existing acts which have a direct impact on the implementation of fundamental duties, but the Wildlife Segregation Act does not align with this focus.
 
• The mentioned acts like the **Representation of People Act, 1951**, the **Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955**, and the **Unlawful Activities Protection Act, 1967** are more closely related to ensuring citizens adhere to fundamental duties.
 
• The Wildlife Segregation Act primarily deals with the conservation and protection of wildlife, which is a significant issue but not directly related to fundamental duties as outlined in the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Representation of People Act, 1951**__

 __
 
• This act provides the framework for the conduct of elections in India.
 
• It is crucial for maintaining the democratic process and ensuring the proper functioning of the government.
 
• The act includes provisions to prevent electoral malpractices and corruption.
 
 
 
• **Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955**__
 __
 
• This act aims to abolish untouchability and prevent discrimination based on caste.
 
• It is essential for promoting equality and social justice in India.
 
• The act is aligned with the fundamental duty to renounce practices derogatory to the dignity of women and individuals.
 
 
 
• **Unlawful Activities Protection Act, 1967**__
 
 
• This act aims to prevent unlawful activities and associations in India.
 
• It is significant for maintaining the sovereignty and integrity of the nation.
 
• The act supports the fundamental duty to uphold and protect the unity and integrity of India.
